completeness.why: The income-only-in-tracking and hidden/hidden-group rules are all decided by isMonthFillCategory (via getMonthFillCategories for the list-based actions, directly on budget rows for copyPreviousMonth), with the preserved differences selected by an explicit scope argument ('all' for setZero, 'visibleOrUngrouped' for copyPreviousMonth, 'visible' for the averages); both sign inversions go through averageToBudgetAmount. No site keeps its own filter or sign branch.

interface.why: One scope parameter names exactly the real variations, including the setZero and missing-group inconsistencies made explicit and commented; no speculative options, and the sign helper takes just the category's is_income and the average.

disguised_duplication.where: The per-action SQL filters, income checks and both sign inversions were removed in favour of isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories/averageToBudgetAmount in server/budget/actions.ts.
